units.source_text: 源氏公子笑道：“这花是难得开的，不容易盼待吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji laughed and said, "This flower rarely blooms, so it must have been hard to wait for it."

units.source_text: 老僧受了源氏公子赏赐的杯子，感激涕零，仰望着公子吟道：

en.t: The old monk received the cup Prince Genji had bestowed on him, and, moved to tears with gratitude, looked up at the prince and recited:
